4Return after time

              ARTICLE AND CASE DESK

              A compact reference

              MasculineFeminineNeuterPlural
              Nominativederdiedasdie
              Accusativedendiedasdie
              Dativedemderdemden + n
              Genitivedes + s/esderdes + s/esder

              Ask what the noun is doing. The subject points to nominative. A direct target often takes accusative. A recipient or location after many prepositions often takes dative.
